splitter.$description: Splitter: panes side by side or one under the other, as many as needed, a handle between each two that drags and takes the keys; a pane may be hidden from its handle.

size.$description: The handle's thickness, the track it takes between two panes.

active-width.$description: The line under the pointer or while dragged.

grip-length.$description: The grip in the middle of the handle, along it.

handle.$description: The bar of a handle, the separator that drags and takes the keys (`focus`).

line.$description: The line along the handle (`active`: under the pointer or dragged; `disabled`); its thickness is `splitter.line-width`, `splitter.active-width`.

grip.$description: The grip in the middle of the handle (`active`; `disabled`: also while it cannot be moved); its size is `splitter.grip-length` × `splitter.grip-thickness`.

fold.$description: The button at an end of the grip that hides the pane beside the handle, or shows it again: `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`.

fold-glyph.$description: The arrow in a fold button: `bg` its colour, `size` its size.
